Career Quest synthetic dataset
nodes.rationale: Synthetic data: 60 skills, 8 roles x 4 grades, 200 employees, 40 events and 2,743 participation records.

nodes.label: Snapshot date 2026-10-01
nodes.rationale: Treat 2026-10-01 as today. History window: 2024-10-01 through 2026-09-30.

nodes.label: skills.json skill catalog
nodes.rationale: Skills have skill_id, name, hard or soft type, category and description.

nodes.label: Skill proficiency scale 0-5
nodes.rationale: All skill levels use the same 0-5 scale.

nodes.label: role_profiles by role and grade
nodes.rationale: Each role/grade has required_skills and critical_skills. Grade order: Junior, Middle, Senior, Lead; requirements never decrease.

nodes.label: required_skills minimum levels
nodes.rationale: Map skill_id to the minimum level for the target grade.

nodes.label: critical_skills promotion requirement
nodes.rationale: Critical skills must meet the requirement to hold a grade and are key for promotion.

nodes.label: employees.json employee profiles
nodes.rationale: employee_id E0001-E0200; synthetic name, department, role, grade, manager, hire date and work format.

nodes.label: Employee assessed skills
nodes.rationale: Map skill_id to level 0-5. A missing skill is level 0; levels reflect the last assessment.

nodes.label: last_review_date unapplied completion gains
nodes.rationale: Activities completed after last_review_date are not yet included in employee skill levels.

nodes.label: career_goal nullable role and grade
nodes.rationale: A goal contains target_role and target_grade; null means no goal has been set.

nodes.label: preferred_language kk ru en
nodes.rationale: The UI language preference is kk, ru or en.

nodes.label: manager_id department lead
nodes.rationale: Manager is a Lead from the same department; null for department heads.

nodes.label: events.json development catalog
nodes.rationale: Events contain role and grade audiences, format, effort, developed skills, prerequisites and sessions.

nodes.label: develops_skills gain and max_level
nodes.rationale: Completion raises a skill by gain, capped at max_level. Compliance events have no skill gains.

nodes.label: Event prerequisites minimum skills
nodes.rationale: Map skill_id to minimum required proficiency to join an event.

nodes.label: Mandatory HR events excluded from recommendations
nodes.rationale: Mandatory events are assigned by HR and are not recommendation targets.

nodes.label: self_paced available anytime
nodes.rationale: Self-paced events have no upcoming sessions because they are available at any time.

nodes.label: activity_history.csv participation log
nodes.rationale: One row per employee participation in an event; references employee_id and event_id; sorted by date, employee_id, event_id.

nodes.label: Participation completed in_progress dropped no_show declined overdue
nodes.rationale: completed=100%; in_progress=0-95%; dropped=5-95%; no_show=0 and scheduled only; declined=0; overdue=0-95 and mandatory.

nodes.label: EV_036 recurring club repeat exception
nodes.rationale: An event cannot repeat after completion, except EV_036 recurring club.

nodes.label: EV_004 first month onboarding
nodes.rationale: New employees complete EV_004 in their first month.

nodes.label: Load additional evaluation profiles and history
nodes.rationale: Evaluation supplies extra employee profiles and history records in the same schema; the solution must load them.

nodes.label: HackAlem AI Halyk Bank challenge
nodes.rationale: Task commissioner is Halyk Bank; allowed tools include cloud and local LLM, STT and TTS.

nodes.label: Career Quest employee development navigator
nodes.rationale: Employees need to see how development activities connect to a career trajectory.

nodes.label: Voice Router alternative challenge
nodes.rationale: The document includes detailed requirements for the alternate voice routing case; those are not Career Quest feature requirements.

nodes.label: LLM meaningful decision layer
nodes.rationale: Process real user input with an LLM at a meaningful decision point; cosmetic text generation alone does not meet the minimum.

nodes.label: Explainable decisions and uncertainty
nodes.rationale: AI is not the sole source of truth; show uncertainty and explain decisions.

nodes.label: Employee and manager development decisions
nodes.rationale: For Case 1 the employee and manager retain the development decision.

nodes.label: No public employee rankings
nodes.rationale: Public employee rankings are explicitly prohibited for Case 1.

nodes.label: Repository README reproducible solution
nodes.rationale: Repository and README required; reproducibility and README score 25 of 100 points.

nodes.label: Legacy Six public core API operations
nodes.rationale: load_dataset, import_test_data, list_employees, get_employee_view, complete_activity, get_hr_view. View keys: employee, next_grade, skills, history, recommendations, trajectory.

nodes.label: Legacy Copy validate commit UI mutations
nodes.rationale: UI completes and imports on a copy, adopts data only after success and deletes temporary upload files. Core completion itself mutates the passed dataset; core import returns a new dataset.

nodes.label: Legacy Internal dataset schema
nodes.rationale: as_of_date, employees, events, skills, role_profiles, history. Import adds unique IDs and validates merged references, grades, levels, dates and statuses.

nodes.label: Legacy Completion gains and assessment baseline
nodes.rationale: max(before,min(max_level,before+gain)); only completed strictly after last_review_date, sorted date/record_id. Same-day completion updates baseline to prevent double replay.

nodes.label: Legacy Deterministic recommendation eligibility
nodes.rationale: Voluntary, audience role/grade match, prerequisites satisfied, available session or self-paced, not previously completed. EV_036 may recur but never twice on snapshot date.

nodes.label: Legacy Weighted benefit and history ranking
nodes.rationale: Benefit caps useful gain by gap; critical skill weight 3, others 1. Score=10*benefit/(1+0.5*same_failures+0.15*similar_failures)+2*in_progress+format_bonus-0.05*hours. Event ID breaks ties.

nodes.label: Legacy Required-skill coverage progress
nodes.rationale: Progress=sum(min(current,required))/sum(required)*100, rounded to 0.1. Lead target/next grade is null but requirements remain Lead.

nodes.label: Legacy HR aggregates without AI calls
nodes.rationale: Count employees with positive gaps; participation includes all history statuses. No recommendation does not indicate poor performance. HR uses use_ai=False.

nodes.label: Legacy Validated AI event and reason indices
nodes.rationale: AI may choose among first three candidates within max(1,10% top score); response event_id and 3-4 unique valid reason indices. Existing deterministic reasons remain intact; free prose is rejected.

nodes.label: Legacy AI deterministic fallback guarantees
nodes.rationale: Invalid response, provider error or timeout preserves baseline recommendations. No names, employee IDs or raw history sent. Live API not checked; mocked tests do not prove model availability.

nodes.label: Streamlit 1.64.0 runtime
nodes.rationale: The application pins streamlit==1.64.0.

nodes.label: Career Quest HR growth application
nodes.rationale: Employee portfolio, HR assessment and learning approval built on 200 starter-kit employees, 60 skills, 40 events and 2,743 history rows.

nodes.label: Six HR trait assessments
nodes.rationale: HR records hire date and six 0-5 ratings: resilience, communication, initiative, analysis, discipline, teamwork. An unassessed profile shows an empty radar grid.

nodes.label: Tenure and approved learning XP
nodes.rationale: 10 XP per full day since hire date, floored at zero for future dates; 100 XP per approved certificate; each 1,000 XP gives another game level. Current calendar date is used, unlike starter-kit snapshot date. Game level is not job grade.

nodes.label: Certificate review and skill awards
nodes.rationale: Submitted certificates remain pending; only HR approval gives 100 XP and chosen +1 catalog-skill awards capped at 5. Approval without a skill award is allowed. Final decisions and duplicate courses cannot be reapplied.

nodes.label: Training requests and HR decisions
nodes.rationale: An employee requests a course from a found plan. HR approval or rejection is recorded with reason. Training approval performs no purchase and grants no XP or completion.

nodes.label: Persistent SQLite growth records
nodes.rationale: Hire dates, ratings, certificates, decisions, AI plans and spending ledger persist in .career-quest/growth.sqlite3. Runtime DB contents are excluded from this knowledge graph.

nodes.label: Explicit AI development tracks
nodes.rationale: One explicit user action requests personalized specialization or exploration tracks from approved skills, certificates and HR traits. Factual basis is displayed separately from AI prose.

nodes.label: GPT-4.1 mini Responses search
nodes.rationale: The implemented model is fixed to gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 using OpenAI Responses, Structured Outputs and one web_search call. Live provider availability is unverified.

nodes.label: Provider domain and URL validation
nodes.rationale: A returned course URL must match a search source and an allowed education-provider domain. This checks provenance, not independent course quality or future price.

nodes.label: Minimized AI portfolio facts
nodes.rationale: Role, grade, goal, skills, approved course facts and HR traits are sent. Name, employee_id, hire date and certificate evidence are omitted. Free course titles/tags remain untrusted input.

nodes.label: Durable AI spending reservations
nodes.rationale: Application maximum $5, per-request maximum $0.10; environment can only lower caps. SQLite reserves the whole request cap before network access and accounts concurrently across the same DB. The ledger is not the provider account balance.

nodes.label: Conservative provider usage accounting
nodes.rationale: One search, max 3,000 output tokens, no auto retries; usage is conservatively charged. Unknown cost or timeout retains the whole reservation; crashed reservations persist. Pricing constants are documented assumptions dated 2026-09-23, not re-verified by this graph task.

nodes.label: Seven-day portfolio plan cache
nodes.rationale: Plans are cached for seven days and keyed to approved portfolio facts. Changed facts invalidate applicability; stale plans cannot create training requests.

nodes.label: Bounded AI failure fallback
nodes.rationale: Wait is bounded at 28 seconds. Missing keys give an explicit unavailable status with no invented results. Deterministic starter-kit route and HR operations remain available.

nodes.label: Managed AI versus legacy reranking
nodes.rationale: The new UI disables legacy automatic AI reranking on page views. Paid research is explicitly requested through growth_ai; legacy core.ai and its configuration remain available to the original API.

nodes.label: Starter-kit simulation and growth separation
nodes.rationale: Route completion simulates a starter-kit activity in session data. Learning XP comes only from HR-approved certificates; confirmed external portfolio and core HR overview are separate.

nodes.label: Development map from core facts
nodes.rationale: Solid lines represent develops_skills, dashed lines prerequisites; up to five target skills initially displayed. Levels and projections come from core; graphical selection uses lists.

nodes.label: Session imports and persistent HR identity
nodes.rationale: Employee/history imports validate together and add unique IDs atomically. Imported profiles and simulated route changes remain session data; after restart reimport the same ID to reconnect persistent HR records.

nodes.label: Prototype identity and review limits
nodes.rationale: Employee/HR switch is a demo mode without identity authentication. Certificate evidence is a URL/number; no automatic document validation, resubmission or final-decision appeal. HR edit history is incomplete.

nodes.label: Mock and browser growth verification
nodes.rationale: Tests cover source data, XP, ratings, certificate decisions, idempotency, training decisions, caching, sources, timeout and concurrent budget reservations. growth_browser_check starts an isolated server with temporary DB and traverses real Chromium pages; only AI response is mocked. Live API remains unverified.

nodes.label: Preserved simulation baseline skills
nodes.rationale: Stores original skills in session dataset before legacy same-date completion mutates baseline. snapshot reuses that copy and excludes UI_ history, keeping simulation gains outside the HR-approved portfolio.

nodes.label: profiles SQLite table
nodes.rationale: Persistent HR hire date and six trait ratings keyed by employee_id.

nodes.label: certificates SQLite table
nodes.rationale: Pending/approved/rejected certificate payloads, unique course fingerprints, HR awards and reasons.

nodes.label: plans SQLite table
nodes.rationale: AI plan payloads with employee_id, portfolio fingerprint and created_at.

nodes.label: training_requests SQLite table
nodes.rationale: Training request payloads and HR decisions, unique per employee and URL.

nodes.label: ai_calls SQLite table
nodes.rationale: Durable request status, reserved/charged micro-dollars and usage records.
